w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.

— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: Nadia watches how you handle mayapple — files it away. Learning by watching.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Inspiration is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/12/7), with 6 wave-4 fought, 20 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 13 · Craft 8 · Talk 28 → 24 · capped · Explore 42 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Mireille Kimbembe ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
